nested.reference: complete actual version_ref/path/kind and optional sha256; normalize member path using reversible Linux filename semantics; do not add or drop other supplied association fields
nested.intent: entire original immutable install intent, including original intent_ref, base/output versions, binding, exec/generation and staged object

rules: The purpose argument remains existing purpose; context.operation is actual public API operation. Authorization and reference callbacks for the same operation receive the same operation context.
No implicit two-argument fallback. Literal True only; unsupported callback signature or callback exception maps to UNAUTHORIZED or REFERENCE_INVALID.

Root and target-parent identity are independently observed by F. archive bytes/hash come from exactly the opened bytes to be sealed. version_ref is validated against actual Git blobs before approval returns data or materializes.
Actual context must be copied finite JSON: checker mutation cannot change the original API request, later context, destination, or data selection.

Authorization may run after independent read-only identity/hash observations necessary to form context, but before creating a new version/root, returning data, exchanging directories or removing a pin.
Existing intent/materialization/capture retries retain complete original ID binding and never reuse a new context to silently overwrite it.
retain/gc/query_install remain original trusted host methods, no new model or business API.
